about: Declarations that began in each county, by hazard (flood, storm, wildfire) and season (winter, spring, summer, fall), 2000-01-01 to 2026-10-09. Generated by scripts/climate/build-hazard-history.mjs from the FEMA declarations (src/core2/data/disasters/declarations.json). A county missing here had none.
source: FEMA OpenFEMA DisasterDeclarationsSummaries v2 (declarations since 2000) and PublicAssistanceFundedProjectsSummaries v1 (federal obligated amounts, disasters declared since 2020), U.S. government works (17 U.S.C. 105); fetched by src/core2/tooling/fetch-disasters.ts.
